context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: There's a half-eaten piece of bread on the table. I toss it into my mouth without a second thought.|

context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: This is -- the same morning as always --.|

context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: My name is Rengo.|

context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: I make my home in a grimy warehouse deep in the forest, living day to day however I please.|

context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: I don't have any particular trade, but I do whatever work I can manage.|

context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: Fortunately, I have clients, so I've never gone hungry.|

context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: Though in exchange, my life tends to come with more than its share of trouble.|

context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: But if I don't take on work like this, there's nowhere else for someone like me to live.|

context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: After all, I was born into a clan of Bug wielders -- the "Bug Users."|

context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: Unfortunate as it is, they're a hopelessly anachronistic lot, still living quietly out of sight in the forest to this da

context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: A mouth that spread wide in a circle, lined with dozens of fangs.|

context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: They interlocked and ground against each other in a complex motion, and the insect was broken down piece by piece.|

context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: It couldn't have taken more than ten seconds, but the sound of a living creature being crushed during that time was, as

context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: A shiver ran down my spine as I simply watched in silence while the Bug finished its meal.|

context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: As if I myself were devouring 'something' in the same way -- savoring that strange, inexplicable sensation...|

context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: The job went the same as it always did.|

context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: The method of contact, the nature of the request, the deadline, and so on--------|

context_entries.speaker: Rengo
context_entries.text: Rengo|"Hey, sorry about that.| I'm just a tiny bit late."|

context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: When I arrived at the meeting spot, the person I'd expected was there waiting for me.|

context_entries.speaker: NARRATION
context_entries.text: A woman who didn't so much as change her expression at the sight of me -- at least thirty minutes late.|

translations.speaker: Girl
translations.japanese:
少女
「わあぁ…………」
translations.translated:
Girl
"Wow..."

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
頭上に広がる茜色の空を見上げて、少女は思わず感嘆
の声を漏らした。
translations.translated: Looking up at the crimson sky spreading above her, the girl let out an involuntary gasp of wonder.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
今までに見たこともないほどの真っ赤な夕焼けが、
柔らかく少女に降り注いでいる。
translations.translated:
A blazing red sunset unlike anything she had ever seen
was washing over her in soft waves of light.

translations.speaker: Girl
translations.japanese:
少女
「綺麗だねぇ……」
translations.translated:
Girl
"It's beautiful..."

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: それは、素直な言葉。
translations.translated: Simple, honest words.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
昼と夜の隙間だけに許されたこの瞬間を、少女は心か
ら綺麗だと感じた。
translations.translated: This fleeting moment -- permitted only in the gap between day and night -- the girl felt from the bottom of her heart was truly beautiful.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
恐怖と苦痛にとらわれていた時間は終わり、得られた
ものは、なにものにも縛られることのない自由。
translations.translated: The time spent trapped in fear and pain had ended, and what she had gained in its place was a freedom bound by nothing.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: 目の前に続くのは一本の道。
translations.translated: Before her stretched a single road.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
少女が夕焼けを見つめていると、まるで少女を導くか
のように、風が頬を撫でた。
translations.translated: As the girl gazed at the sunset, the wind brushed her cheek -- as if guiding her forward.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: だから――歩き出す――――。
translations.translated: And so -- she began to walk --.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
胸に染み込んでくるような赤い輝きを見つめながら、
少女は確かな足取りで歩き出す。
translations.translated: Her eyes fixed on the red radiance that seemed to seep into her very chest, the girl set off with steady, certain steps.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
その先に何があるのかは分からなかったが、少なくと
も希望を胸に抱くことができた。
translations.translated: She did not know what lay ahead, but at the very least, she could hold hope within her heart.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
以前とは全く違う赤い輝きに、希望を持つことができ
たのだった。
translations.translated: In a red radiance utterly unlike what she had known before, she had found the strength to hope.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.translated: Yes --

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.translated: Unlike before -- different --

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.translated: Red --

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: 赤い炎が――立っていた――――。
translations.translated: Red flames -- were standing there --.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
一切のものを呑み込むほどの勢いで、真っ赤な炎が
狂ったように猛っていた。
translations.translated: With a ferocity that swallowed everything whole, the crimson flames raged as if gone mad.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: それが、悪夢の始まり。
translations.translated: That was the beginning of the nightmare.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: これから少女が体験する、苦痛と恐怖の幕開け。
translations.translated: The opening curtain of pain and terror the girl was about to endure.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
肌を焼くような熱から伝わってきたものは、捻じ曲げ
られた運命への嘲笑のように感じられた。
translations.translated: What reached her through the skin-scorching heat felt like mockery -- a sneer aimed at a fate twisted beyond recognition.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: 全てが失われていく。
translations.translated: Everything was being lost.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: 幸せだった平穏な生活が、全て灰と化していく。
translations.translated: The peaceful, happy life she had known was turning to ash, every last piece of it.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: 少女にできるのは、ただ見つめることだけ。
translations.translated: All the girl could do was watch.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
炎が全てを焼き尽くすのを、ただ見つめることだけ
だった。
translations.translated: All she could do was watch as the flames consumed everything.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
やがて、失ったものの代わりに与えられたのは、おぞ
ましき苦痛の中から産まれ出た――――
translations.translated: In time, what was given to her in place of all she had lost -- born from within unspeakable agony --

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: 薄汚れた倉庫の部屋で、呻くような声を漏らす。
translations.translated: In a grimy warehouse room, a low groan escapes.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
埃まみれのソファーに寝転がって、そのままの体勢で
大きく伸びをする。
translations.translated: Sprawled out on a dust-caked sofa, I stretch out without bothering to move from that position.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
周囲に白い粉のようなものが舞ったが、今更そんな
もんを気にするような神経は持っちゃいない。
translations.translated: A cloud of something like white powder drifts up around me, but I stopped caring about that kind of thing a long time ago.

translations.japanese:
？？？
「なんだ、もう朝か？」
translations.translated:
???
"What, morning already?"

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: 寝起きのせいか、ガラガラの声が出る。
translations.translated: My voice comes out raspy -- probably from just waking up.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
首だけを動かして辺りを窺ったあと、オレは気だるげ
に溜息を漏らした。
translations.translated: After scanning the room with just my eyes, I let out a sluggish sigh.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: いつも通りの倉庫の部屋。
translations.translated: Same old warehouse room.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
多少、汚いのは認めるが、オレにとっちゃそれなりに
快適な隠れ家だ。
translations.translated: I'll admit it's a bit of a dump, but for me it's a reasonably comfortable hideout.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: 壁や床には、動物や昆虫じゃない生き物――――
translations.translated: Crawling across the walls and floor are creatures that are neither animals nor insects --

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
――『蟲』が動き回っていて、忙しないと言えば忙し
ない雰囲気が漂っている。
translations.translated: -- "Bugs" -- scurrying about, giving the place a restless, busy sort of atmosphere.

translations.japanese:
？？？
「……ったく、あんま寝た気がしねーな」
translations.translated:
???
"...Damn, doesn't feel like I slept much."

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: ソファーから起き上がって、ボキボキと首を鳴らす。
translations.translated: I haul myself off the sofa and crack my neck.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
テーブルの上には食べかけのパンがあって、それを
無造作に口の中に放り込んだ。
translations.translated: There's a half-eaten piece of bread on the table. I toss it into my mouth without a second thought.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: これが――いつも通りの朝――――。
translations.translated: This is -- the same morning as always --.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: オレの名は煉悟。
translations.translated: My name is Rengo.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
森の中にある薄汚い倉庫を住処として、気ままにその
日暮らしをしている。
translations.translated: I make my home in a grimy warehouse deep in the forest, living day to day however I please.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
仕事はこれといって決めてないが、まあやれる事はや
るって感じだ。
translations.translated: I don't have any particular trade, but I do whatever work I can manage.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
幸いにして依頼者もいるため、食う物に困ったことは
ない。
translations.translated: Fortunately, I have clients, so I've never gone hungry.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
……もっとも、その代わりに面倒事が多い生活だった
りもするんだが。
translations.translated: Though in exchange, my life tends to come with more than its share of trouble.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
だが、そんな仕事でも請けて行かなければ、オレみた
いな奴が生きてく場所は他にない。
translations.translated: But if I don't take on work like this, there's nowhere else for someone like me to live.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
何しろオレは蟲を使う一族――『蟲使い』の生まれだ
からだ。
translations.translated: After all, I was born into a clan of Bug wielders -- the "Bug Users."

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
不幸なことに、これがとんでもなく時代錯誤な連中で、
今でも人知れずひっそりと森の中に住んでいる。
translations.translated: Unfortunate as it is, they're a hopelessly anachronistic lot, still living quietly out of sight in the forest to this day.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
ガキの頃から違和感はあったんだが、大人になるにつ
れ、それがどんどん大きくなっていった。
translations.translated:
I'd felt something was off since I was a kid, but as I got older,
that feeling only kept growing.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: なんでこんな生活をしなきゃならないのか。
translations.translated: Why did I have to live like this?

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: もっと楽に暮らす方法があるんじゃないのか。
translations.translated: Wasn't there some easier way to get by?

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
そんな事を考えているうちに、周りの連中が馬鹿みた
いに思えてきて、オレは一族を抜けた。
translations.translated: Thinking along those lines, the people around me started to look like fools, and I left the clan.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
掟を破って一族を抜けて、それで今に至ってるってわ
けだ。
translations.translated: I broke the code, walked out on the clan, and that's how I ended up where I am today.

translations.speaker: Rengo
translations.japanese:
煉悟
「そういや、今日は仕事があるんだったな」
translations.translated:
Rengo
"Come to think of it, I've got work today."

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
窓から差し込む陽の高さを見て、うっすらと目を細め
る。
translations.translated: I squint slightly as I gauge the height of the sun streaming through the window.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
仕事と言っても大したもんじゃないが、確か待ち合わ
せの時間があったはずだ。
translations.translated: It's nothing major as far as jobs go, but I'm pretty sure there was a set meeting time.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: もうそろそろ出ないと間に合わない――――
translations.translated: I need to leave soon or I won't make it--------

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
――いや、今から行ってもアウトな気はするが、とに
かく出かける準備をしなければならなかった。
translations.translated: ----No, I have a feeling I'm already too late even if I leave now, but either way, I had to get ready to head out.

translations.speaker: Rengo
translations.japanese:
煉悟
「いや、待てよ。
　蟲どもに餌を喰わせるんじゃなかったか？」
translations.translated:
Rengo
"Wait, hold on.
 Wasn't I supposed to feed the Bugs?"

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: 身支度を整えながら、ふともう一つの用事を思い出す。
translations.translated: While getting myself ready, I suddenly remember another errand.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
どっちかって言えばこっちのほうが重要で、飼ってる
蟲どもに餌を食わせるため、近くの森に寄る予定だっ
たのだ。
translations.translated: If anything, this one's more important -- I'd planned to stop by the nearby forest to feed the Bugs I keep.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
一族を抜けたと言っても、蟲を使わなくなったわけ
じゃない。
translations.translated: Just because I left the clan doesn't mean I stopped using Bugs.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
むしろ、数少ない蟲を維持するために、それなりに
世話をしながら暮らしていた。
translations.translated: If anything, I was living with the effort of maintaining the few Bugs I had, taking care of them as best I could.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
急いで仕事に向かうか、それとも蟲どもに餌を食わせ
るか。
translations.translated: Rush off to work, or feed the Bugs first.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: オレは、行きながら考える事にした……。
translations.translated: I decided I'd figure it out on the way...

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
やって来たのは、倉庫からそう遠くない場所にある森
だった。
translations.translated: I ended up at a forest not far from the warehouse.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
餌場は幾つかあるが、距離の関係でここに来る事が
一番多い。
translations.translated: There are several feeding grounds, but this one is the closest, so I come here most often.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: 蟲どもを解放して、自分達で餌を獲らせることにした。
translations.translated: I released the Bugs and let them hunt for their own food.

translations.speaker: Rengo
translations.japanese:
煉悟
「オォラ、行って来ォい！」
translations.translated:
Rengo
"Go on, get out there!"

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
オレの服の内側から、拳程度の大きさのダンゴムシの
ような蟲がのそのそと這い出てくる。
translations.translated: From inside my clothes, Bugs the size of fists -- shaped like pill bugs -- come crawling out one by one.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: その数、ざっと二十匹。
translations.translated: About twenty of them in all.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
蟲使いが蟲を仕込む方法は幾つかあるが、オレはだい
たい着衣の内側に隠すことにしていた。
translations.translated: There are several ways Bug Users conceal their Bugs, but I generally keep mine hidden inside my clothing.

translations.speaker: Rengo
translations.japanese:
煉悟
「ま、一時間くらいでいっかァ？」
translations.translated:
Rengo
"Eh, an hour or so should do it?"

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: 木陰に移動して、その根元に腰を下ろす。
translations.translated: I move into the shade of a tree and settle down at its base.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
休むための理由もあるが、基本的には身を隠すのが
目的だ。
translations.translated: There's a reason to rest, but the main purpose is to stay out of sight.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
何しろ蟲を放している時の蟲使いは、完全な無防備と
言っていい。
translations.translated: After all, a Bug User who has released their Bugs is completely defenseless -- no two ways about it.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: 今、敵に襲われでもすると、何かと厄介な事になる。
translations.translated: If an enemy were to attack me right now, things could get very messy.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
あまり隠れたり逃げたりするのは趣味ではないが、こ
ればっかりは仕方なかった。
translations.translated: Hiding and running aren't really my style, but in this case, there's no helping it.

translations.speaker: Rengo
translations.japanese:
煉悟
「そォろそろ頃合か」
translations.translated:
Rengo
"About time, I'd say."

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
ひゅうっ、と口笛を吹いて、森の中にいる蟲達に合図
を送る。
translations.translated: I let out a sharp whistle, signaling to the Bugs scattered through the forest.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
すると暫くして、ゴソゴソと地面を這うようにしなが
ら、蟲達がオレの足元に戻ってきた。
translations.translated: A little while later, they came crawling back across the ground to my feet, rustling as they moved.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: 一応数も確認してみるが、しっかり揃っていた。
translations.translated: I do a quick headcount -- all present and accounted for.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
蟲達はオレの脚を躊躇いもなく這い上がり、上着の
内側へとその姿を消した。
translations.translated: The Bugs crawled up my legs without a moment's hesitation and disappeared inside my jacket.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
――と、その中の一匹が途中で動きを止め、口から
赤い触手をひゅんっと飛ばした。
translations.translated: -- Then one of them stopped mid-climb and shot a red tendril from its mouth with a sharp snap.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
その矢のようなスピードは、とても外見からは想像で
きない速さだ。
translations.translated: The arrow-like speed was something you'd never expect from its appearance.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
触手は茂みの中に隠れていた昆虫の胴体を串刺しにし、
そのまま本体のところまで引き寄せてくる。
translations.translated: The tendril skewered an insect hiding in the undergrowth straight through the body and dragged it back to the Bug.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: 蟲は、昆虫が口元まで来たのを確認すると――――
translations.translated: Once the Bug confirmed the insect had been pulled up to its mouth--------

translations.speaker: Rengo
translations.japanese:
煉悟
「クヒッ、意地汚い奴め」
translations.translated:
Rengo
"Khih -- greedy little bastard."

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
大きく円形に広がった口と、その中に生えている何十
という牙。
translations.translated: A mouth that spread wide in a circle, lined with dozens of fangs.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
それらが複雑に絡み合い、擦り合うようにして、昆虫
はその体を分解されていった。
translations.translated: They interlocked and ground against each other in a complex motion, and the insect was broken down piece by piece.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
時間にして十秒もなかっただろうが、その間に聞こえ
ていた『生き物が潰れる音』は、やはりとても心地良
い。
translations.translated: It couldn't have taken more than ten seconds, but the sound of a living creature being crushed during that time was, as always, deeply satisfying.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
背筋にぞわりとするものを感じながら、オレはただ
じっと蟲が食事を終えるのを見守っていた。
translations.translated: A shiver ran down my spine as I simply watched in silence while the Bug finished its meal.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
まるでオレ自身も、『何か』を同じように食っている
ような、そんな不思議な感覚を味わいながら……。
translations.translated: As if I myself were devouring 'something' in the same way -- savoring that strange, inexplicable sensation...

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: 仕事は、いつも通りと言えばいつも通りだった。
translations.translated: The job went the same as it always did.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: 接触方法、依頼内容、期限等々――――。
translations.translated: The method of contact, the nature of the request, the deadline, and so on--------

translations.speaker: Rengo
translations.japanese:
煉悟
「よぅ、悪いなァ。
　ちぃ～～っとばっかし遅れちまったぜぇ」
translations.translated:
Rengo
"Hey, sorry about that.
 I'm just a tiny bit late."

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
待ち合わせ場所に行ってみると、予想した通りの人物
がオレを待っていた。
translations.translated: When I arrived at the meeting spot, the person I'd expected was there waiting for me.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
少なくとも三十分以上遅刻したオレを見ても、表情
一つ変えない女。
translations.translated: A woman who didn't so much as change her expression at the sight of me -- at least thirty minutes late.

translations.speaker: Yuria
translations.japanese:
ユーリア
「前回の報酬です」
translations.translated:
Yuria
"This is your payment for the last job."

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
女はまず、封筒に包まれた札束を手渡しでよこしてき
た。
translations.translated: The woman handed over an envelope stuffed with bills.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
これがいつものパターンで、だいたい前回の仕事の報
酬と、次の仕事の依頼内容を同時に聞くことにしてい
る。
translations.translated: This was the usual pattern -- I'd collect payment for the previous job and hear the details of the next one at the same time.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
もろちん、最初の頃はもっと段階を踏んでやり取りを
していたんだが、オレの飽きっぽい性格もあって、今
の形に落ち着いたってわけだ。
translations.translated: Of course, in the early days we went through more steps when exchanging information, but given my restless nature, things eventually settled into this arrangement.

translations.speaker: Yuria
translations.japanese:
ユーリア
「こちらが、次の依頼書になります」
translations.translated:
Yuria
"This is the request form for your next job."

translations.speaker: Rengo
translations.japanese:
煉悟
「あいよ」
translations.translated:
Rengo
"Sure thing."

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: 女の手から、同じ封筒がもうひとつ手渡される。
translations.translated: Another envelope, identical to the first, was passed from the woman's hand to mine.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
依頼書と言っているが、実際はそんないいもんじゃな
い。
translations.translated: She called it a request form, but in reality it was nothing so fancy.

translations.speaker: Yuria
translations.japanese:
ユーリア
「それと、今日はサンプルをいただく日ですので」
translations.translated:
Yuria
"Also, today is the day I collect the sample."

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: 淡々とした様子で、女が話を進めていく。
translations.translated: The woman continued speaking in her usual detached manner.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
その間、オレはロクに喋ってないのだが、そのあたり
は全く気にしてないらしい。
translations.translated: I had barely said a word this whole time, but she didn't seem to mind in the slightest.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
代わりに、今まで一度としてオレのほうを見ようとも
しなかった女の視線が、本当に一瞬だけちらりと向け
られる。
translations.translated: In place of that, the woman's gaze -- which had not once turned in my direction until now -- flicked toward me for just a brief instant.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
そして、そこから流れるように自分が右肩から提げて
いたハンドバッグに移すと、それで話は終わりだと言
わんばかりに顔を反対に向けた。
translations.translated: Then, in one fluid motion, it shifted to the handbag hanging from her right shoulder, and she turned her face the other way as if to say the conversation was over.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
まあ、何をしろと言われているのかは、ちゃんと伝わ
るんだけどよ……。
translations.translated: Well, I could tell well enough what she was asking me to do...

translations.speaker: Rengo
translations.japanese:
煉悟
「クヒヒッ！　せいぜい奴の役に立ってやれよ」
translations.translated:
Rengo
"Kuhihi! Make yourself useful to the guy, you hear me."

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
オレは、衣服の内側にいる蟲を一匹摘み出すと、素早
くハンドバッグの中に落とした。
translations.translated: I reached inside my clothing, pinched out one of the Bugs, and dropped it swiftly into the handbag.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
その重さを確認してか、女がちらりとハンドバッグの
ほうに視線を送る。
translations.translated: Perhaps confirming its weight, the woman cast a brief glance toward the handbag.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
中身は見えていないだろうが、ゴソゴソと蠢く感覚は
伝わっているはずだ。
translations.translated: She probably couldn't see what was inside, but she must have felt the rustling, squirming sensation.

translations.speaker: Yuria
translations.japanese:
ユーリア
「では……」
translations.translated:
Yuria
"Well then..."

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
そう言って会釈をして、女は人ごみの中へと消えて
いった。
translations.translated: With those words and a small bow, the woman disappeared into the crowd.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese: これで、今日の仕事は終わりだった……。
translations.translated: And with that, the day's work was done...

translations.speaker: Rengo
translations.japanese:
煉悟
「……ったく、ふざけた事ばっかりゴチャゴチャぬか
　しやがってよォ」
translations.translated:
Rengo
"...Damn, what a load of nonsense to dump on me all at once."

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
倉庫に戻って依頼書を開いて、オレは盛大な溜息とと
もに不満を漏らしていた。
translations.translated: Back at the warehouse, I opened the request form and let out a long, heavy sigh as I grumbled my complaints.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
封筒の中には便箋が一枚と、ビタミン剤のようなもの
が三錠。
translations.translated: Inside the envelope was a single sheet of writing paper and three tablets that looked like vitamin pills.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
便箋には汚らしい、読むのも一苦労するような字で、
錠剤を蟲の食事として与えろと書かれていた。
translations.translated: The writing paper bore a messy scrawl -- the kind that took real effort just to read -- instructing me to give the tablets to the Bug as food.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
ちなみに、錠剤を与えるまで二十四時間は何も食わせ
るなとのこと……。
translations.translated: It also noted that the Bug was to be given nothing to eat for twenty-four hours before administering the tablets...

translations.speaker: Rengo
translations.japanese:
煉悟
「そういうのは先に言っとけってんだ、糞野郎ッ！」
translations.translated:
Rengo
"Tell me that kind of thing in advance, you piece of shit!"

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
便箋を床に投げ捨てて、オレは古びたソファーに
どっかと座り込んだ。
translations.translated: I flung the letter to the floor and dropped heavily onto the worn-out sofa.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
スプリングがイカれてるのか、最近はあまり座り心地
が良くない。
translations.translated: The springs must have been shot, because it hadn't been very comfortable to sit on lately.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
まあ、それは別にいいんだが、とにかく今日はもう
食事を与えてしまった。
translations.translated: Well, that was beside the point -- the real problem was that I'd already fed the Bug today.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
この錠剤を使うのは、少なくとも明日以降という事に
なる。
translations.translated: Using these tablets would have to wait until tomorrow at the earliest.

translations.speaker: Rengo
translations.japanese:
煉悟
「忘れてなきゃ飲ますか」
translations.translated:
Rengo
"I'll give 'em to it if I don't forget."

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
錠剤の入った小さなビニール袋を、テーブルの上に
ぽとりと落とす。
translations.translated: I let the small plastic bag containing the tablets fall onto the table with a soft thud.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
こういった依頼は、オレとしてはあまり好ましい類の
仕事じゃない。
translations.translated: This kind of job wasn't really to my liking.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
もう少し肉体労働――と言えば聞こえはいいが、要す
るに暴れられる仕事のほうが喜んでやれるタイプだ。
translations.translated: Something with a bit more physical labor -- "manual work" sounds respectable enough, but what I mean is I'd much rather have a job where I get to cut loose.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
ただ、今のところ収入源はこの依頼主からが唯一で、
その金額も決して悪いものではない。
translations.translated: That said, this client was currently my only source of income, and the pay was far from bad.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
引っ越しなどが面倒臭くてこの場所に住んではいるが、
このソファーの下には札束の入った鞄が三つか四つは
あるはずだ。
translations.translated: Moving was too much of a hassle, so I stayed in this place -- but under this sofa there should have been three or four bags stuffed with cash.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
もっとも、ロクに使うアテもないので、いったい幾ら
持っているのか、自分で把握していないのだが……。
translations.translated: Not that I had much use for it, so I didn't even have a clear grasp of exactly how much I had...

translations.speaker: Rengo
translations.translated:
Rengo
"Hm...?"

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
テーブルの上に置いていた携帯電話が、ボリュームを
最大にして着信音を鳴らす。
translations.translated: The cell phone sitting on the table blared its ringtone at full volume.

translations.speaker: Rengo
translations.japanese:
煉悟
「オイ、今度は何のクスリだ？」
translations.translated:
Rengo
"Hey, what kind of drug is it this time?"

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
通話ボタンを押すなり、オレは目の前にいる奴に話し
かけるように口を開いた。
translations.translated: The moment I hit the answer button, I opened my mouth as if talking to someone right in front of me.

translations.speaker: NARRATION
translations.japanese:
オレに電話を掛けてくる奴など、この世に一人しかい
ないのだから、「もしもし？」などと言うだけ無駄だ。
translations.translated: There was only one person in this world who ever called me, so saying "hello?" would have been a complete waste of breath.

translations.japanese:
？？？
「例の物は飲ませたかね？」
translations.translated:
???
"Have you administered the item in question?"

translations.speaker: Rengo
translations.japanese:
煉悟
「残念だったなァ。
　今日はもう餌食わせちまったからアウトだ」
translations.translated:
Rengo
"Too bad for you.
Already fed it today, so that's a no-go."

translations.japanese:
？？？
「おや、それは残念だ」
translations.translated:
???
"Oh my, that is unfortunate."

translations.speaker: Rengo
translations.japanese:
煉悟
「……って言うかな、このクスリは二十四時間以上
　待たなきゃならねぇのか？」
translations.translated:
Rengo
"...Actually, hold on -- does this stuff really need a twenty-four hour wait beforehand?"

translations.speaker: Rengo
translations.japanese:
煉悟
「オレとしては、食わせるならさっさと食わせたほう
　が楽なんだがなァ？」
translations.translated:
Rengo
"Personally, if I'm going to give it something, I'd rather just get it over with."

translations.japanese:
？？？
「その場合、こちらの実験では九割の蟲が一時間以内
　に死亡しているが、それでも君が良いと言うのなら
　私としては別に構わんよ」
translations.translated:
???
"In that case, our experiments show that nine out of ten Bugs die within an hour under those conditions -- but if you say you're fine with that, I have no particular objection."

translations.speaker: Rengo
translations.japanese:
煉悟
「ふっざけんなッ！
　それで、『はい分かりました』って蟲に食わせると
　でも思ってんのかッ！！」
translations.translated:
Rengo
"The hell I will!
Do you really think I'm just going to say 'sure, understood' and feed it to the Bug?!"
